answer.reason: DeclineReason is coarser than the vendor's set. The adapter maps only insufficient_funds and expired_card one for one, while do_not_honor and lost_card have no mapping of their own and appear to fall into the domain's catch-all 'other'. The core branches on the three members only to choose a customer message (DECLINE_MESSAGES in CheckoutService), and the type's doc comment says "in our own words".
